deployed: Forge 0.5.0 released: loader @version 0.5.0, @require pinned to forge_bundle.js at dcaa1465 via jsDelivr, @x-release-pending removed by release_pin.yml.

Repo-backed image packs live in the shipped bundle: runner/imgpack.mjs (contract), storage/assets.mjs (digest-keyed asset cache + content-keyed upload ledger), core/imagepack.mjs (prepare/commit/gate).
forge/tools/make_image_pack.mjs authors a pack by reading blobs with git cat-file at a resolved commit, so an uncommitted file cannot be bound.
Two independent review rounds closed: F1 (Start did not bind the verified File) and F2 (stale preparation could write into a newer selection), both corrected and re-reviewed CLOSED.
Forge bundle budget stepped twice within this feature to 470,000 raw / 92,000 gzip; the bundle is at ~96% of both.
art/godstorm/ holds the eight approved processed WebPs with a README recording their provenance, verification and the command that regenerates the pack.
push/53_godstorm_failed_items_repair.json now carries an imagePack binding all eight images to 10fb2570 by path + SHA-256; validate.py 0 errors, 9 pre-existing warnings.
make_image_pack.mjs --write writes at the repository's one-space indent, so a pack insertion is a 45-line diff instead of a 2,762-line reformat.
Two drift guards keep the committed pack honest against the committed blobs, and forge.yml checks out with fetch-depth 0 so they can actually run in CI.
